dedupe_keys.name: piarc international climate change adaptation framework for road infrastructure 2023 technical report

description: The PIARC International Climate Change Adaptation Framework 2023 is a technical report (2023R28EN) from Technical Committee 1.4 that helps road organisations identify adaptation principles and increase the climate resilience of transport assets, operations and services. The library page says climate change is a strategic risk to road organisations, that projections show gradual changes in average climate and changes in the frequency, severity and location of extremes, with significant effects on design, construction, operation, maintenance and use of roads, and that unlike the 2015 framework the 2023 version does not prescribe a single approach. Coverage: road agencies worldwide. Format and access: PDF (17.4 MB) from the PIARC virtual library, which uses a personal space for downloads. Licence and cost: under PIARC terms. Caveats: guidance, not data. It supports climate adaptation and resilience planning by road agencies. It relates to the PIARC case study collection and the FHWA resilience pilots in the catalogue.
